names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 19 ianuarie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 19 Ιανουαρίου, «Όσιοι Μακάριος ο Αιγύπτιος και Μακάριος ο Αλεξανδρεύς», with the rank word left off.

hymns.text: Locuitor pustiului, înger în trup şi de minuni făcător te-ai arătat, purtătorule de Dumnezeu, Părintele nostru Macarie. Cu postul, cu privegherea şi prin rugăciune primind daruri cereşti, tămăduieşti pe cei bolnavi şi sufletele celor ce aleargă la tine cu credinţă. Slavă Celui Ce ţi-a dat ţie putere; Slavă Celui Ce te-a încununat pe tine; Slavă Celui Ce lucrează prin tine tuturor tămăduiri.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Macarie Egipteanul, Glasul 1

english.text: A dweller of the wilderness, an angel in the body and a worker of wonders wast thou shown to be, O God-bearing Macarius our father. Receiving heavenly gifts by fasting, by vigil and by prayer, thou healest the sick and the souls of those who run to thee in faith. Glory to him who gave thee strength; glory to him who crowned thee; glory to him who works healings for all through thee.

hymns.text: Viaţă fericită ducând în lume, te-ai învrednicit a te sălăşlui în pământul celor blânzi, împreună cu cetele fericiţilor, Sfinte Macarie, purtătorule de Dumnezeu; şi locuind în pustiu, ca într-o cetate, ai primit de la Dumnezeu harul minunilor. Pentru aceasta te cinstim.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfântului Cuvios Macarie Egipteanul, Glasul 1, «Ceata îngerească...»

english.text: Leading a blessed life in the world, thou wast counted worthy to dwell in the land of the meek with the ranks of the blessed, O God-bearing Saint Macarius; and dwelling in the wilderness as in a city, thou didst receive from God the grace of wonders. Therefore do we honour thee.

hymns.text: Τῆς ἐρήμου πολίτης καί ἐν σώματι ἄγγελος, καί θαυματουργός ἀνεδείχθης, θεοφόρε Πατήρ ἡμῶν Μακάριε· νηστείᾳ ἀγρυπνίᾳ προσευχῇ, οὐράνια χαρίσματα λαβών, θεραπεύεις τούς νοσοῦντας, καί τάς ψυχάς τῶν πίστει προστρεχόντων σοι. Δόξα τῷ δεδωκότι σοι ἰσχύν, δόξα τῷ σέ στεφανώσαντι, δόξα τῷ ἐνεργοῦντι διά σοῦ πᾶσιν ἰάματα.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’, on the page of Όσιοι Μακάριος ο Αιγύπτιος και Μακάριος ο Αλεξανδρεύς; the hymn is the common of a venerable ascetic, printed there under the two names

english.text: A citizen of the wilderness and an angel in the body wast thou shown to be, and a worker of wonders, our God-bearing father Macarius; by fasting, vigil and prayer thou didst receive heavenly gifts, and thou healest the sick and the souls of those who run to thee in faith. Glory to him who gave thee strength, glory to him who crowned thee, glory to him who works healings for all through thee.

hymns.text: Ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Κύριος, τῆς ἐγκρατείας, ἀληθῶς σε ἔθετο, ὡσπερ ἀστέρα ἀπλανῆ, φωταγωγοῦντα τά πέρατα, Πάτερ Πατέρων, Μακάριε Ὅσιε.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, «Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον», on the page of Όσιοι Μακάριος ο Αιγύπτιος και Μακάριος ο Αλεξανδρεύς

english.text: Truly the Lord set thee in the house of abstinence as a star that does not wander, lighting the ends of the earth, O father of fathers, venerable Macarius.
